items.title: The three DISM commands you should know to fix your Windows system images
items.summary: This article highlights three specific DISM commands that users can utilize to maintain their Windows operating system. These commands help in identifying and repairing corrupted system files.
items.blurb: Check and repair damaged system files with these DISM commands.

items.title: The biggest downsides to using Apple's Magic Mouse
items.summary: The article explores common complaints regarding Apple's Magic Mouse despite its unique touch gestures. Understanding these drawbacks can assist users in determining if the device is the right fit for their workspace.
items.blurb: Mac users have their reasons for ditching Apple's Magic Mouse despite its slick touch gestures. Knowing them can help you decide if it suits your desk.

items.title: Commons reasons your Android phone's icons won't move and how to fix it
items.summary: Android users experiencing issues with movable home screen icons can likely resolve the problem through their device settings. The article explains common causes and provides steps to fix these layout restrictions.
items.blurb: It's most likely your home screen settings.

items.title: What you can do with your old, discontinued Mac Pro
items.summary: Following the discontinuation of the Mac Pro, this article offers advice on how to continue utilizing the hardware. Even without official Apple support, owners can find functional ways to repurpose their old machines.
items.blurb: Apple is discontinuing Mac Pro, but there are several ways you can still get use out of the computer, even without Apple support.

items.title: The hacker behind early GTA VI leaks has been sentenced — and released
items.summary: Arion Kurtaj has been sentenced to seven years in prison for hacking companies including Rockstar Games and Uber. Despite the sentence, he has been released on license after leaking GTA VI content.
items.blurb: Arion Kurtaj, who pleaded guilty last week to hacking Grand Theft Auto VI developer Rockstar Games and other companies, including Uber and Revolut, was sentenced to seven years in prison but released on license, the BBC reports. After hacking Rockstar, Kurtaj leaked 90 videos of GTA VI in 2022, years before the game's public release […]

items.summary: The Verge has published its 2026 holiday gift guide to help readers select thoughtful presents for others. It emphasizes that gift-giving is a meaningful expression of connection.
items.blurb: Gift-giving isn't just about grabbing something solid under a determined spending limit. It's an expression of love, a way to show someone how well you really know them. items.title: Figma employee sues, alleging company forced her to confront harassers
items.summary: A Figma employee has initiated a lawsuit against the company and its CEO. The allegations involve sexual harassment and workplace discrimination.
items.blurb: Figma and its CEO are being sued by a current employee for alleged sexual harassment and discrimination.

items.title: Can you fix a scratched CD? Here are your options
items.summary: As CDs see a resurgence in popularity, this article outlines various methods for repairing scratched discs. Options range from simple DIY techniques to seeking professional restoration services.
items.blurb: It's true: CDs are experiencing a revival. If you've got scratched discs, there are options for fixing them, from DIY methods to seeking professional help.

items.title: Ladybird, the first new browser engine in years, is now available to test
items.summary: Ladybird, a web browser featuring a unique browser engine, is now available for alpha testing on macOS and Linux. Developed by Andreas Kling, it represents the first browser in years built with an entirely new engine.
items.blurb: Ladybird, an independent web browser with a built-from-scratch engine, is finally available for testing. On Monday, Ladybird developer Andreas Kling announced that the browser is launching in alpha on macOS and Linux following more than four years of development. The release makes Ladybird the first browser in years to arrive with an entirely new engine. […]

items.title: Trump engineered a risky comeback for Jensen Huang
items.summary: Following a resignation triggered by personal scandal, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has returned to his position. Donald Trump publicly supported Huang's recovery after news of the executive's affairs emerged.
items.blurb: After Nvidia's board accepted Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO, following reports that Huang had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, President Donald Trump, too, appeared to submit to the new reality. Appearing on Stephen A. Smith's radio show shortly after the news came out, Trump said that Huang would "end up on his feet." […]

items.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship, letting AI agents review, fix, and approve code changes
items.summary: Anthropic has introduced Claude Ship, a suite of developer tools designed to automate code review approvals. By allowing AI agents to manage these routine tasks, the company aims to speed up software development workflows.
items.blurb: As AI-generated code piles up, Anthropic's new developer tools aim to eliminate another bottleneck by letting agents handle routine approvals.

items.title: Supertake raises $20M to let AI agents turn your market predictions into stock portfolios
items.summary: Startup Supertake has secured $20 million in funding to develop an AI-powered platform for stock portfolios. The service uses AI agents to translate user market predictions into actual investment trades.
items.blurb: Think you know where the market is headed? A startup called Supertake lets you put money behind your ideas without having to pick the stocks yourself.

items.title: Elon Musk and others rejoice as Jensen Huang is reinstated at Nvidia amid scandal

items.blurb: "The mistake has been corrected," Elon Musk chimed in.

items.title: Megaspeed, the company at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal, appears headed for a US blacklist
items.summary: Megaspeed, the company embroiled in the Jensen Huang scandal, may soon be added to a U.S. government blacklist. This action would restrict the ability of American companies to conduct business with the firm.
items.blurb: Megaspeed, which was previously led by Alice Huang, would be barred from doing business with U.S. companies unless those companies attained a special license from the federal government.

items.title: Your older, discontinued AirTags can still serve a purpose
items.summary: Apple's original AirTags can still be useful despite the release of newer models. The article provides tips on how to repurpose these older tracking devices for various home and travel needs.
